doc: Stage several files with Magit (D-run-table, D-decode-emacs): run from magit.changed-files makes one row a changed file (section, path -- absolute), each row calling magit.stage-file through the intent command. Leave a row out with - before run start; a staged row staged again changes nothing. To unstage instead, write intent magit.unstage-file path="{path}" in the rows wanted. A failure is the frame's ! line (err).
